szoveg_eredeti:
We’re turning lessons from defending OpenAI into practical tools for our customers.

Working with a frontier model, we identified and resolved important vulnerabilities in our own code and infrastructure. That experience is informing the tools and playbooks we’re building to help other security teams strengthen their defenses.

President and Co-Founder Greg Brockman shares what we’ve learned and why security teams should keep putting the latest models to work as capabilities improve.

Join OpenAI’s Cyber at the Frontier livestream on November 12 at 10 a.m. PT. 

Register at the link in the comments.
